content.title: 毛坯房顺序完工｜表面施工、木作、家具与照明验收
content.summary: 锁定同一房间几何与机位，装修按墙面、地板、固定木作、家具和灯光的依赖顺序逐层出现；前一阶段必须保持为后一阶段的基础，最终用完整可用空间收束。

quick_start.input_format: 固定空房＋施工依赖顺序＋家具进入＋完整验收
quick_start.recommended_input: 空水泥阅读室、暖白墙面、橡木地板、胡桃木书架、沙发和吊灯。
required_anchors: 先完成固定施工再进家具
终局保留所有前置层级
usage_steps: 把示例主体、场景和表层元素替换为原创概念。
让每个必需锚点和 Creative DNA 不可变条件都能在画面因果链中被看见。
选择 MiniMax H3 或 Seedance 2.0 模板，只填写已声明的可替换项。
生成前检查时长、事件顺序、镜头连续性、声音和反复制约束。
applicable_scope: 锁定同一房间几何与机位，装修按墙面、地板、固定木作、家具和灯光的依赖顺序逐层出现；前一阶段必须保持为后一阶段的基础，最终用完整可用空间收束。
能够保留全部必需锚点的原创 4–15 秒短片。
需要可复用因果视频结构的 MiniMax H3 或 Seedance 2.0 项目。
not_suitable_for: 要求复制来源人物、场景、道具、对白或镜头顺序的任务。
无法在目标时长内展示全部必需锚点的概念。
缺少紧凑因果链的长篇讲解或无关多地点叙事。

creative_dna.mechanism: 锁定同一房间几何与机位，装修按墙面、地板、固定木作、家具和灯光的依赖顺序逐层出现；前一阶段必须保持为后一阶段的基础，最终用完整可用空间收束。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One camera and room geometry remain fixed.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One camera and room geometry remain fixed."

invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Construction follows shell-to-finish dependency order."

invariants.rule: Openings are never lost or relocated.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Openings are never lost or relocated."

invariants.rule: Movable furniture arrives after fixed work.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Movable furniture arrives after fixed work."

invariants.rule: The final hold shows a complete usable room with every prior layer retained.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final hold shows a complete usable room with every prior layer retained."

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: all source faces, bodies, wardrobe, identities and creator-specific character designs
the source location, set dressing, props, products and exact environmental geometry
all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
